about: Writing a View State's and a Query's JSON (ADR-0207): the text the C# core writes, byte for byte, which reads back as what was written, and what writing refuses; and a View State made from a grid's columns, and one refused when it is made. Transcribed from dotnet/tests/ExGrid.Tests/GridViewStateJsonTests.cs and QuerySerialisationTests.cs.
